description:
You will join a new dedicated team taking full ownership of a live, fast-growing consumer app in the US. As one of the first engineers on the team, you will shape how the mobile app is built, tested and released from day one.

You will be an excellent fit for this position if you have:

  • 5+ years of frontend or mobile development, including 3+ years building production React Native apps released on the App Store.
  • Strong TypeScript and modern React skills (hooks, component architecture), plus state management with Redux Toolkit, Zustand, React Query or similar.
  • Hands-on experience with animation in React Native: Lottie, Reanimated and Gesture Handler, keeping complex animations smooth at 60 fps.
  • Solid knowledge of iOS tooling and releases: Xcode, CocoaPods, signing and provisioning, TestFlight and App Store review.
  • Deep understanding of React Native performance: JS and UI threads, list rendering, memory, startup time and app size.
  • Experience integrating with backend services over REST and WebSockets, plus push notifications, deep links and in-app payments such as Apple Pay.
  • Ability to take over an existing codebase with limited documentation: map how it works, document key flows and stabilize it.
  • Experience with automated testing (Jest, React Native Testing Library) and mobile CI/CD (Fastlane, EAS, GitHub Actions or similar).
  • Upper-Intermediate English or higher, and readiness for a few hours of daily overlap with US Eastern time.

Nice to have

  • Native iOS development in Swift, including writing native modules for React Native.
  • Experience with Expo and EAS, or with the React Native New Architecture (Turbo Modules, Fabric).
  • Experience building live video streaming or real-time chat features in mobile apps.
  • Android release experience.
  • Familiarity with Sentry and product analytics tools such as Amplitude or Mixpanel.
  • React web experience.

Responsibilities:
  • Take over the existing React Native app through knowledge transfer, map its architecture and document key flows.
  • Build and polish pack-opening and card-reveal animations together with the UI/UX designer.
  • Deliver new features.
  • Develop the mobile side of live features: streamed pack openings, real-time auctions and chat.
  • Improve app performance, stability and crash-free rate as the user base grows.
  • Own the iOS release process: builds, TestFlight, App Store submissions and hotfixes.
  • Work with the Java backend team on API contracts and real-time integrations.
